# AIDP role and privilege matrix (sample)

Generated from [`roles.yaml`](roles.yaml). Design and rationale: [roles-and-privileges.md](roles-and-privileges.md). 15 roles, 110 groups across 3 environments and 5 domains.

## Roles

| Role | Tier | Kind | Extends | Group | Environments | Approver | Duration | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `break-glass` | break-glass | human | - | `aidp-break-glass` | dev, qa, prod | CISO + SRE lead (two-person) | jit (sealed in PAM, alert on use, review every use) | Recover the platform when normal admin paths are broken. |
| `platform-observer` | platform | human | - | `aidp-prod-platform-observer` | dev, qa, prod | SRE lead | standing | See platform health without seeing business data. |
| `platform-operator` | platform | human | `platform-observer` | `aidp-prod-platform-operator` | dev, qa, prod | SRE lead | standing in dev/qa, change ticket in prod | Run the platform day to day - deploy, scale, restart, quotas, kill runaway queries. |
| `platform-admin` | platform | human | `platform-operator` | `aidp-prod-platform-admin` | dev, qa, prod | SRE manager (not the requester) | jit (max 4 h, ticket required) | Change platform configuration - cluster RBAC, Keycloak clients, storage tenants. |
| `security-auditor` | security | human | - | `aidp-security-auditor` | dev, qa, prod | CISO | standing | Verify controls independently - read access rules, logs and events, never data. |
| `access-admin` | security | human | - | `aidp-access-admin` | dev, qa, prod | IAM lead | standing | Add and remove people from aidp-* groups in AD / Entra after the role approver signs off. |
| `domain-reader` | data | human | - | `aidp-prod-finance-reader` | dev, qa, prod | domain owner | standing | Use the domain's published data products. |
| `domain-steward` | data | human | `domain-reader` | `aidp-prod-finance-steward` | dev, qa, prod | domain owner | standing | Own data quality and classification - tags, masks, row filters, DQ rules. |
| `domain-owner` | data | human | `domain-steward` | `aidp-prod-finance-owner` | prod | CDO | standing | Accountable for the domain - approves access requests and prod releases. |
| `domain-engineer` | data | human | `domain-reader` | `aidp-prod-finance-engineer` | dev, qa, prod | domain owner | standing | Build the domain's pipelines - full control in dev, read-only in QA and prod. |
| `pii-reader` | data | human | - | `aidp-prod-finance-pii-reader` | dev, qa, prod | domain owner + privacy officer | time-bound (max 90 days) | Add-on for a named purpose - read the domain's masked tables with PII unmasked. |
| `ml-engineer` | ai | human | `domain-engineer` | `aidp-qa-finance-ml-engineer` | dev, qa | domain owner | standing | Train, evaluate and register models on the domain's data. |
| `model-approver` | ai | human | `domain-reader` | `aidp-prod-finance-model-approver` | prod | AI governance council | standing | Approve promotion of a model version to the prod champion alias. |
| `ai-app-user` | ai | human | - | `aidp-prod-ai-app-user` | dev, qa, prod | business manager | standing | Use approved AI assistants through the AI gateway. |
| `svc-pipeline` | workload | service | - | `aidp-prod-finance-svc-pipeline` | dev, qa, prod | domain owner (via the release pipeline) | standing (client credentials, 5 min tokens) | The only identity that writes a domain's tables in QA and prod (named svc-<env>-<domain>-pipeline). |

## Query layer (Data Analytics Engine) - effective grants

Schemas are `iceberg.<env>_<domain>_<layer>`; grants include inherited roles. Enforced in the lab by the generated [Trino policy](../labs/env/trino/roles/rules.json).

| Role | Effective grants |
|---|---|
| `break-glass` | everything |
| `platform-observer` | system catalog read; others' queries: view |
| `platform-operator` | others' queries: view/kill; system catalog read; others' queries: view |
| `platform-admin` | others' queries: view/kill; system catalog read; others' queries: view |
| `security-auditor` | system catalog read; others' queries: view |
| `access-admin` | - |
| `domain-reader` | read consumption in dev/qa/prod |
| `domain-steward` | read curated in dev/qa/prod; read consumption in dev/qa/prod |
| `domain-owner` | read curated in prod; read consumption in prod |
| `domain-engineer` | owner raw/curated/consumption in dev; read curated in qa/prod; read consumption in dev/qa/prod |
| `pii-reader` | PII unmasked |
| `ml-engineer` | owner raw/curated/consumption in dev; read curated in qa; read consumption in dev/qa |
| `model-approver` | read consumption in prod |
| `ai-app-user` | - |
| `svc-pipeline` | owner raw/curated/consumption in dev/qa/prod; PII unmasked |

## Privileges per component

Inherited privileges are marked with the role they come from.

### trino

| Role | Privileges |
|---|---|
| `domain-steward` | approves changes to the domain's policy rules in Git (CODEOWNERS) |
| `domain-owner` | approves access to the domain's roles; approves prod releases of the domain (B08 four-eyes); approves changes to the domain's policy rules in Git (CODEOWNERS) *(from `domain-steward`)* |

## Separation of duties

| Must not be held together | Why |
|---|---|
| `security-auditor` + `platform-admin` | auditors must not administer what they audit |
| `security-auditor` + `access-admin` | whoever grants access must not audit it |
| `access-admin` + `domain-owner` | the approver and the person who applies the grant must differ |
| `ml-engineer` + `model-approver` | a model builder must not approve their own model for prod |
| `platform-admin` + `pii-reader` | an admin with unmasked data can bypass every control |
| `platform-admin` + `domain-engineer` | admins do not build business pipelines in the same environment |
